en: The workers struggled against the poor working conditions.
cn: 工人们与恶劣的工作条件斗争。

en: He suffers from severe headaches.
cn: 他因严重的头痛而受苦。

en: The company supplies us with office equipment.
cn: 公司供给我们办公设备。

en: Remember to take along your umbrella, it looks like rain.
cn: 记得携带你的雨伞，看起来要下雨了。

en: Please take away your dirty dishes.
cn: 请带走你的脏盘子。

en: Can you take care of my plants while I’m gone? || She has to take care of her younger siblings.
cn: 我不在的时候你能照顾我的植物吗？ || 她必须照顾她的年幼的兄弟姐妹。

en: Take down the notes carefully; Take off your hat indoors.
cn: 仔细写下笔记；在室内脱掉你的帽子。

en: Plants take in carbon dioxide.
cn: 植物吸收二氧化碳。

en: The wind took off his hat. || The plane will take off in ten minutes; Take off your coat.
cn: 风把他的帽子带离了。 || 飞机将在十分钟内起飞；脱下你的外套。

en: Take out the trash before you leave. || Take out your books and turn to page ten.
cn: 在你离开前取出垃圾。 || 拿出你的书，翻到第十页。

en: Did you take part in the school sports meeting?
cn: 你参加学校运动会了吗？

en: The meeting will take place tomorrow.
cn: 会议将在明天发生。

en: The furniture takes up too much space in the room. || She decided to take up painting as a hobby.
cn: 这家具占据了房间太多的空间。 || 她决定学着做绘画作为消遣。

en: We spent the evening talking about our future plans.
cn: 我们花了一晚上谈论我们未来的计划。

en: I need some time to think about your offer. || I need some time to think about your proposal.
cn: 我需要一些时间来思考你的提议。 || 我需要一些时间来考虑你的提议。

en: What do you think of my new dress? || I am thinking of changing my job.
cn: 你认为我的新裙子怎么样？ || 我正在考虑换工作。

en: It's important to think of oneself sometimes.
cn: 有时为自己着想是很重要的。

en: I often think of my old school days; We need to think about the consequences.
cn: 我经常想起我的旧学校时光；我们需要考虑后果。

en: It is rude to throw things at people.
cn: 朝别人扔东西是很不礼貌的。

en: Don't throw stones at the birds.
cn: 不要向鸟儿扔石头。

en: Don't throw away old clothes, you can donate them.
cn: 不要扔掉旧衣服，你可以捐赠它们。

en: Tidy up your room before your friends come over.
cn: 在你朋友来之前整理你的房间。

en: I need to tidy up my room before guests arrive. || Could you tidy up the papers on your desk?
cn: 客人们到来之前我需要收拾一下我的房间。 || 你能整理一下你桌上的文件吗？

en: We spent the afternoon touring around the museum.
cn: 我们花了一个下午游览博物馆。

en: The country trades with several Asian nations.
cn: 这个国家与几个亚洲国家贸易。

en: Can you translate this sentence into French?
cn: 你能把这个句子翻译成法语吗？

en: They plan to travel around Europe for a month.
cn: 他们计划环游欧洲一个月。

en: He tricked his friend into helping him cheat.
cn: 他诱使他的朋友帮他作弊。

en: Can I try on this jacket?
cn: 我可以试穿这件夹克吗？

en: You must try to be on time for the meeting.
cn: 你必须尽力准时参加会议。

en: Turn around and look at me.
cn: 转过身来看着我。

en: She had to turn down the job offer due to low salary.
cn: 由于薪水低，她不得不拒绝这份工作邀请。

en: The rain turned into snow.
cn: 雨变成了雪。

en: At the corner, turn left and you will see the bank.
cn: 在拐角处，向左转，你就会看到银行。

en: Please turn off the lights when you leave. || Please turn off the lights when you leave the room.
cn: 你离开时请关闭灯。 || 离开房间时请关掉灯。

en: Can you turn on the air conditioner?
cn: 你能打开空调吗？

en: Turn over the page and continue reading.
cn: 翻转页面继续阅读。

en: Turn the paper over and start writing.
cn: 把纸翻过来开始写字。

en: The caterpillar will turn to a butterfly.
cn: 毛毛虫会变成蝴蝶。

en: Please wait for me at the entrance.
cn: 请在入口等我。

en: I woke up at six this morning.
cn: 我今天早上六点醒来。

en: We walked along the river bank.
cn: 我们沿着河岸走。

en: We had to walk through a dense forest.
cn: 我们不得不走过一片茂密的森林。

en: We walked up the hill to see the view.
cn: 我们向上走去山丘看风景。

en: The heavy rain washed away the loose soil.
cn: 大雨把松散的泥土洗掉了。

en: I'll cook dinner if you wash up afterwards.
cn: 如果你之后洗碗，我就做晚饭。

zh: 使疲倦；磨损；穿破；使疲惫
en: The long hike wore us out; The shoes quickly wore out. || My old jacket is completely worn out.
cn: 长途徒步使我们疲倦；鞋子很快磨损了。 || 我的旧夹克已经完全穿破了。

en: He works as an engineer for a big company. || She works as a teacher in a high school.
cn: 他在一家大公司从事工程师的工作。 || 她在高中担任一名教师。

en: The team is working on a new software update.
cn: 团队致力于一个新的软件更新。

en: I can't work out this math problem; I work out at the gym daily.
cn: 我算不出这个数学题；我每天在健身房锻炼。

en: I enjoy working with intelligent people.
cn: 我喜欢与聪明的人从事工作。

en: Don't worry about the small details.
cn: 不要担心这些小细节。

en: Write down the address so you don't forget it.
cn: 写下地址，这样你就不会忘记了。

en: Write to the editor; Write about your travels; Write for a magazine.
cn: 写信给编辑；写关于你的旅行；为杂志写作。

en: I need to write to my grandmother.
cn: 我需要写信给我的祖母。

en: According to the report, the economy is recovering.
cn: 根据报告所说，经济正在复苏。

en: The game was canceled as a result of the heavy rain.
cn: 由于大雨，比赛被取消了。

en: The hurricane extended its effects as far as the coast.
cn: 飓风将其影响延伸到沿海地区。

en: The shares were sold at a discount.
cn: 这些股票折价出售。

en: The rare coin was sold at a high price.
cn: 这枚稀有硬币以高价售出。

en: I was at a loss for words.
cn: 我一时不知说什么好。

en: She can swim for an hour at a stretch.
cn: 她能一口气连续游上一个小时。

en: Take two pills at a time.
cn: 每次服两粒药。

en: The train was traveling at a high speed.
cn: 火车正以高速行驶。

en: We must win at all costs.
cn: 我们必须不惜一切代价取胜。

en: The baby weighed six pounds at birth.
cn: 这个婴儿出生时重六磅。

en: We usually discuss our plans at breakfast.
cn: 我们通常在早餐时讨论我们的计划。

en: The host made us feel at ease.
cn: 主人让我们感到自在。

en: At first glance, it looks easy.
cn: 乍一看这似乎很容易。

en: They fell in love at first sight.
cn: 他们一见钟情。

en: The exam is at hand.
cn: 考试临近了。

en: He spoke at length about the plan.
cn: 他详细地谈了这个计划。

en: The clock struck twelve at midnight.
cn: 午夜时分，时钟敲了十二下。

en: It takes at most ten minutes.
cn: 最多花十分钟。

en: He finished the whole novel at one sitting.
cn: 他一口气读完了整本小说。

en: The lake was at peace at dawn.
cn: 黎明时湖面一片平静。

en: Pick a card at random.
cn: 随便抽一张牌。

en: Many children are at risk.
cn: 许多孩子处于危险之中。

zh: 在短时间内通知；仓促间
en: We cannot leave at short notice.
cn: 我们不能说走就走。

en: She started university at the age of eighteen.
cn: 她在十八岁时开始上大学。

en: The garden shed is at the back of the house.
cn: 花园棚屋在房子的后面。

en: The school year starts at the beginning of September.
cn: 学年在九月开始的时候开始。

en: The message was written at the bottom of the page.
cn: 信息写在页面的底部。

en: Be careful when you walk at the crossing.
cn: 你在十字路口行走时要小心。

zh: 在...的尽头；在...的末尾；在...末
en: Our office is at the end of the corridor. || The final results will be announced at the end of the month. || The meeting will finish at the end of the hour.
cn: 我们的办公室在走廊的尽头。 || 最终结果将在本月的末尾公布。 || 会议将在这一小时的末尾结束。

en: We waited for him at the entrance to the museum.
cn: 我们在博物馆的入口等他。

en: The village is situated at the foot of the mountain.
cn: 村庄位于山脚下。

en: The speaker stood at the front of the room.
cn: 演讲者站在房间的前部。

en: The house is located at the tip of the island.
cn: 这座房子位于岛的尖端。

en: What are your plans for at the weekend?
cn: 你周末有什么计划？

en: The two countries are at war.
cn: 这两个国家处于交战状态。

en: My father is at work right now.
cn: 我父亲现在在上班。

en: The game was canceled because of the heavy rain.
cn: 比赛因为大雨被取消了。

en: The library is located between the bank and the post office.
cn: 图书馆位于银行和邮局之间。

en: I found the old photo by accident.
cn: 我意外地发现了这张旧照片。

en: I found the old photo by accident while cleaning.
cn: 我打扫时偶然发现了这张旧照片。

en: We decided to ship the goods by sea.
cn: 我们决定通过海路运送货物。

zh: 乘公共汽车/打的/乘飞机
en: We travelled to the airport by car.
cn: 我们乘车去机场。

en: I met him by chance.
cn: 我偶然遇见了他。

en: The letter was written by hand.
cn: 这封信是手写的。
